A LITTLE HELP

Good to know
before you visit.

Simple answers to everyday questions.

Can I order through this website?

Online ordering is not available yet. The catalogue is illustrative and does not show live stock or confirmed prices.

How do I check product availability?

Check with the store before purchasing. Call 03000000002 or send a WhatsApp enquiry using the store contact buttons below.

What if I have a prescription?

Bring your prescription when you visit and ask the store team about the item you need. This website does not provide diagnosis or treatment advice.

Are delivery and opening hours available?

Store hours are 8:00 AM–10:00 PM. Please call to confirm holiday hours and any delivery arrangements.
